start.why: L0042 is from a completely separate earlier scene (scene 3 in bedroom talking to her mom) spliced in as an awkward prologue before jumping to scene 8 with Gowtham. The clip functions much better as a coherent dialogue starting directly when Amrutha asks him about his matchmaking history (L0165).

end.why: Cutting right at L0205 cuts off Amrutha's joyful, blushing reaction and smile during the romantic music swelling at L0206, which provides the emotional payoff to her line 'inka avasaram ledu'.

visual_beats_to_include.what: Gowtham notices the small teal plastic stool Amrutha used to stand on to appear taller, and gently kicks/nudges it away with his foot, then steps close to her.
visual_beats_to_include.why: This is a pivotal physical gesture demonstrating that he rejects the expectation for her to artificially seem taller, perfectly setting up his dialogue at L0185.

reaction.what: Amrutha looks down with a shy, bashful smile, touched that she doesn't need to ask her second question because Gowtham accepted her completely.

clean_edges.note: Starting at L0042 is an abrupt edit across different scenes. Ending directly on L0205 cuts off the musical release and Amrutha's blushing visual beat in L0206.
